title: First-run setup
note: The eight steps the setup screen renders, in order. Every step records where the person can change the answer later. The autonomy step carries no preselected option.

steps.title: What this is
steps.explanation: Vivarium gives you an agent you raise yourself. It remembers what you let it remember, asks before it acts outside your bounds, and shows you what it did. Setup takes a few minutes and every answer can be changed later.

steps.title: Where the agent thinks
steps.explanation: Choose at least one route to a model. A subscription you already pay for, your own API key, or a model running on this machine. Keys stay with you: the desktop app keeps them in this computer's credential store.

choices.label: Use a subscription I already have
Use a model on this machine

steps.title: How much you want to see
steps.explanation: Simple keeps the machinery out of the way and shows the result. Advanced shows the plan, the tools it used, and the settings behind each decision while the work runs.

steps.title: What it may do without asking
steps.explanation: Pick a level. At 1 the agent asks about almost everything; at 5 it handles routine work and tells you afterwards. Nothing is chosen for you, and you can change it per kind of action later.

choices.label: 2: ask me before anything that leaves this computer
3: handle your own files, ask before sending
4: handle routine work, ask about money and deletions
5: handle routine work and tell me afterwards

steps.title: How it should reach you
steps.explanation: Choose where questions land, and when nothing may interrupt. Every question names the setting that caused it, with a Change link.

choices.label: Hold them in an inbox for when I return

steps.title: What it may read
steps.explanation: Turn on the routes you want. On the web, the agent reaches your device only through these: files you drop in, connected accounts, a browser extension, its own browser, or a paired companion. You can see and revoke each route at any time.

choices.label: Files I upload or drag in
A browser extension on pages I choose

steps.title: Your first agent
steps.explanation: Start from a template or from a blank page. Give it a name, a character in your own words, and the job you want it to take on. Templates are examples; the agent is yours.

steps.title: What you chose
steps.explanation: One screen with every answer and a Change link beside it. Nothing starts until you press Finish, and each line points at the setting it came from.
